frequency_question: How often do major centrally-backed industrial electrification or vehicle-subsidy schemes get formally launched by the responsible ministry within 3 to 4 years of initial policy signalling?
membership_rule: Includes central ministry-led incentive/subsidy frameworks targeting commercial vehicle manufacturing or adoption (e.g., FAME phases, PLI auto schemes); excludes state-level programs or minor non-financial guidelines.

cases.name: PLI Scheme for Automobile and Auto Component Industry

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 4 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 4 named major schemes matching the domain, all successfully launched.
known_gaps: Small sub-schemes or delayed drafts that missed initial timelines are omitted, though eventual delivery remains high.
validity_reason: Policy persistence and central administrative priority toward EV manufacturing subsidies remain stable across the current political cycle.
